aiResearchSummary.text: NEOM is developing a system and method for low energy crystallisation of minerals from brine, a brine valorisation system and method for brine mining and mineral recovery, and a selective membrane system and method for desalination and mineral recovery. It is also creating a system and method for producing concrete from brine, a system and method for monitoring an operational environment, and a system and method of orchestration between heterogeneous robots and robots from multiple vendors, covering mineral processing, water treatment, construction, monitoring, and robotics orchestration.
